name: IfFolderExistsNode
label: If Folder Exists
description: Checks whether the specified folder exists or doesn't exist based on the selected condition.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Condition
fields.label: If Folder
fields.description: Select the condition to check for the folder (Exists or Doesn't exist).

selectOptions.label: Does Not Exist
selectOptions.description: Check if the folder does not exist.

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder Path
fields.description: The path of the folder to check for existence.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns true if the folder meets the specified condition, otherwise false.
